libs.note: BH-6736: the Mac gate entrypoint. Remote (bin/remote-gate.sh) by default; --local runs bin/run-tests-in-docker.sh under a slot lock in $TMPDIR/bh-gate-slots. Operator CLI, no cron line, no switch: a switched-off gate must never exit 0. tests/gate-entrypoint.bh-6736-test.sh drives it.

knobs.note: How many bin/gate.sh --local runs may hold a local Docker slot at once on one machine; the next one waits. Read by bin/gate.sh as ${GATE_LOCAL_SLOTS:-2}; a value outside 1..6 is exit 2. Not settable from the control plane: it is a per-machine env value on a Mac, which reads no settings row.
